summary: Fix crash when collecting a gem, broken HUD height counter above 9m, weak spring bounce, and crumbling platforms staying solid after falling.

bugs.title: Collecting a gem crashes the game loop with 'Cannot read properties of null (reading position)'
bugs.evidence: At 0:16 (step 4), collecting a gem sets pl.gem = null and then immediately accesses pl.gem.position.y inside logEvent, throwing a TypeError and freezing the game loop.

bugs.title: HUD height stops updating at 10m or higher
bugs.evidence: In updateHud, the condition `if (h !== shownH && h < 10)` prevents hHeight from updating once maxY reaches 10.

bugs.title: Spring platforms barely bounce the player instead of launching them
bugs.evidence: In land(), spring platforms set `p.vy = JUMP * 0.4` (5.0) instead of `SPRING` (22), making it impossible to reach the next platform generated 4.5 to 6 units higher.

bugs.title: Crumbling platforms stay solid after falling
bugs.evidence: In updatePlatforms(), when `pl.crumbleT > 0.55`, `pl.falling = true` is set, but `pl.active` is never set to `false`, so the player continues standing on invisible air where the platform was.

edits.find:
pl.g.remove(pl.gem); pl.gem = null; gems++;
          logEvent("gem", { platform: pl.id, total: gems, height: pl.gem.position.y });
edits.replace:
pl.g.remove(pl.gem); pl.gem = null; gems++;
          logEvent("gem", { platform: pl.id, total: gems, height: +gy.toFixed(2) });
edits.why: Fix: use computed gem height gy instead of reading position from null pl.gem.

edits.find: if (h !== shownH && h < 10) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.replace: if (h !== shownH) { shownH = h; hHeight.textContent = h; }
edits.why: Fix: update HUD height for all altitudes, not just below 10m.

edits.find:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = JUMP * 0.4; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.replace:
if (pl.type === "spring") {
        p.vy = SPRING; p.springing = true; p.sq = 0.55;
edits.why: Fix: use SPRING velocity when landing on a spring platform so it launches the player to the high next platform.

edits.find: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.replace: if (pl.crumbleT > 0.55) { pl.falling = true; pl.active = false; sfx.crack(); burst(pl.x, pl.y, pl.z, 10, 0.8); }
edits.why: Fix: mark crumbling platform inactive when it falls so it no longer supports the player.

summary: Fix the player character facing backwards relative to its movement direction.

bugs.title: Player character faces opposite to movement direction
bugs.evidence: At 0:13 and 0:33, when the player moves forward away from the camera, the character's eyes and cheeks turn toward the camera (opposite to the velocity vector) because p.face uses Math.atan2(-p.vx, -p.vz) even though the face meshes are on local +Z.

bugs.title: Not a bug: missed jumps at 0:13 and 0:37
bugs.evidence: At 0:13 and 0:37 the player misjudged the jump trajectory and fell off the islands.

edits.why: Fix: rotate the player's local +Z face toward the velocity vector instead of away from it.
